description: The prefixes of a path through a sequence tree form a downward-closed prefix chain contained in the tree and meeting every finite length.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.pathNodes_spec {T : Set (List ℕ)} {x : ℕ → ℕ}
  (hx : x ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.body T) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.pathNodes x ⊆ T ∧
    (∀ s ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.pathNodes x,
        ∀ t ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.pathNodes x, s <+: t ∨ t <+: s) ∧
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.IsSequenceTree (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.pathNodes x) ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ s ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.pathNodes x, s.length = n
